 Saturday’s App State-Georgia State Game Sold Out
 Story Links
 BOONE, N.C. — Saturday's App State football home game against Georgia State is officially a sellout.
The Mountaineers (5-3) will become bowl eligible with their next victory. If you still need tickets, check out SeatGeek to purchase .
All five games in Boone have sold out so far this season. App State has sold out 20 of its last 22 games at The Rock, which has been ranked as a Top 25 stadium in all of college football by ESPN, The Athletic and College Football Campus Tour.
The top five single-season average home attendance marks in App State and Sun Belt Conference history have been those reached by Mountaineer fans at Kidd Brewer Stadium in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025.
 Tickets are still available for App State's Nov. 21 home finale against ULM.
Sport-specific giving allows you to directly support App State student-athletes and help provide them the resources they need to be successful.  Click here to contribute to the App State Football Support Fund .
Keep up with App State Football wherever you go by following the Mountaineers on social media. Follow App State Football on  X ,  Instagram  and  Facebook . Download the App State Athletics App for  iOS  or  Android  to keep the Mountaineers at your fingertips.
